diagnosis: The Deno.serve route fetches organization API keys directly from Deno KV using client-provided orgId and keyId path parameters. While it validates that the caller holds a valid user JWT, it never verifies whether user.id has membership or admin privileges in orgId. An attacker authenticated under one organization can supply another organization's orgId and keyId to extract production secret tokens.
